findings.current: The cold ticking of the [Broken Pocket Watch] I’d tucked deep in my Inventory just before logging in seemed to ring in my ears like a phantom sound.
findings.defect: Square brackets enclose an item name in prose.
findings.rationale: The binding Markdown convention does not use square brackets around UI terms.
findings.replacement: The cold ticking of the Broken Pocket Watch I’d tucked deep in my Inventory just before logging in seemed to ring in my ears like a phantom sound.

findings.current: And if I really were a five-hundred-year-old immortal, the one pulling this eight-horse carriage would be Cheonju, not a horse.
findings.defect: Cheonju leaves the established title untranslated in an English-only reading copy.
findings.rationale: The packet’s binding decision retains “Lord of Heaven” for this title.
findings.replacement: And if I really were a five-hundred-year-old immortal, the one pulling this eight-horse carriage would be the Lord of Heaven, not a horse.
findings.source: Chapter 1178, Taekyung imagining an immortal pulling the carriage

summary: The reading copies and active state are broadly consistent. Two established formatting and terminology choices drift in the English.
